mapper.sql: WITH normalized AS ( SELECT a.id, a.performed_at, a.user_id, a.action_type, a.old_values, a.new_values, NULLIF( COALESCE(a.new_values ->> 'facility_id', a.old_values ->> 'facility_id'), '' )::BIGINT AS facility_id, NULLIF( COALESCE(a.new_values ->> 'indicator_id', a.old_values ->> 'indicator_id'), '' )::BIGINT AS indicator_id, NULLIF( COALESCE(a.new_values ->> 'input_user_id', a.old_values ->> 'input_user_id'), '' )::BIGINT AS reporter_id, COALESCE( NULLIF(a.new_values ->> 'approver_user_id', '')::BIGINT, NULLIF(a.old_values ->> 'approver_user_id', '')::BIGINT, CASE WHEN a.new_values ->> 'status' = 'APPROVED' THEN a.user_id::BIGINT ELSE NULL END ) AS approver_id, COALESCE(a.new_values ->> 'reporting_year', a.old_values ->> 'reporting_year') AS reporting_year, COALESCE(a.new_values ->> 'period_type', a.old_values ->> 'period_type') AS period_type, COALESCE(a.new_values ->> 'period_value', a.old_values ->> 'period_value') AS period_value, COALESCE(a.new_values ->> 'numerical_value', a.old_values ->> 'numerical_value') AS numerical_value, CASE WHEN a.action_type = 'DELETE' THEN 'DELETED' WHEN a.action_type = 'INSERT' AND a.new_values ->> 'status' = 'PENDING' THEN 'APPROVAL_REQUESTED' WHEN a.action_type = 'INSERT' AND a.new_values ->> 'status' = 'APPROVED' THEN 'FINAL_APPROVED' WHEN a.action_type = 'INSERT' AND a.new_values ->> 'status' = 'REJECTED' THEN 'REJECTED' WHEN a.action_type = 'INSERT' THEN 'DATA_CREATED' WHEN a.old_values ->> 'status' = 'PENDING' AND a.new_values ->> 'status' = 'DRAFT' THEN 'APPROVAL_CANCELED' WHEN (a.old_values ->> 'status') IS DISTINCT FROM (a.new_values ->> 'status') AND a.new_values ->> 'status' = 'PENDING' THEN 'APPROVAL_REQUESTED' WHEN (a.old_values ->> 'status') IS DISTINCT FROM (a.new_values ->> 'status') AND a.new_values ->> 'status' = 'APPROVED' THEN 'FINAL_APPROVED' WHEN (a.old_values ->> 'status') IS DISTINCT FROM (a.new_values ->> 'status') AND a.new_values ->> 'status' = 'REJECTED' THEN 'REJECTED' ELSE 'DATA_UPDATED' END AS action_code FROM audit_logs a WHERE a.table_name = 'esg_metric_data' )

where.if: AND normalized.performed_at < (CAST(#{toDate} AS DATE) + INTERVAL '1 day')

mapper.select:
SELECT normalized.id, TO_CHAR(normalized.performed_at, 'YYYY-MM-DD HH24:MI:SS') AS at, COALESCE(reporter.name, actor.name, '시스템') AS reporter, COALESCE(approver.name, '-') AS approver, CASE normalized.action_code WHEN 'DATA_CREATED' THEN '데이터 등록' WHEN 'DATA_UPDATED' THEN '데이터 수정' WHEN 'APPROVAL_REQUESTED' THEN '승인 요청' WHEN 'APPROVAL_CANCELED' THEN '승인 요청 취소' WHEN 'FINAL_APPROVED' THEN '최종 승인' WHEN 'REJECTED' THEN '반려' WHEN 'DELETED' THEN '삭제' ELSE '기타 작업' END AS action, normalized.action_code, normalized.facility_id, COALESCE(facility.facility_name, '기업 공통') AS facility, normalized.indicator_id, COALESCE(indicator.title, '미식별 지표') AS target, CONCAT( '[', COALESCE(facility.facility_name, '기업 공통'), '] ', COALESCE(normalized.reporting_year, '-'), '년 ', CASE WHEN UPPER(TRIM(COALESCE(normalized.period_type, 'MONTHLY'))) = 'YEARLY' THEN '연간' WHEN UPPER(TRIM(COALESCE(normalized.period_type, 'MONTHLY'))) = 'QUARTERLY' THEN CONCAT(COALESCE(normalized.period_value, '-'), '분기') WHEN UPPER(TRIM(COALESCE(normalized.period_type, 'MONTHLY'))) = 'HALFYEARLY' THEN CONCAT(COALESCE(normalized.period_value, '-'), '반기') ELSE CONCAT(COALESCE(normalized.period_value, '-'), '월') END, ' ', CASE normalized.action_code WHEN 'DATA_CREATED' THEN '실적 등록' WHEN 'DATA_UPDATED' THEN '실적 수정' WHEN 'APPROVAL_REQUESTED' THEN '최종 승인 요청' WHEN 'APPROVAL_CANCELED' THEN '승인 요청 취소' WHEN 'FINAL_APPROVED' THEN '최종 공시 확정' WHEN 'REJECTED' THEN '승인 반려' WHEN 'DELETED' THEN '실적 삭제' ELSE '데이터 변경' END, CASE WHEN normalized.numerical_value IS NOT NULL THEN CONCAT(' (수치: ', normalized.numerical_value, ')') ELSE '' END ) AS detail FROM normalized LEFT JOIN users reporter ON reporter.id = normalized.reporter_id LEFT JOIN users actor ON actor.id = normalized.user_id LEFT JOIN users approver ON approver.id = normalized.approver_id LEFT JOIN company_facilities facility ON facility.id = normalized.facility_id LEFT JOIN esg_indicators indicator ON indicator.id = normalized.indicator_id
ORDER BY normalized.performed_at DESC, normalized.id DESC LIMIT #{size} OFFSET #{offset}
